five_minutes: Slower US Q2 GDP growth of 1.5% reinforces Fed rate cut expectations and helps cap US Treasury yields.
Nvidia's $96bn quarter beat forecasts, confirming strong global demand for AI infrastructure.
US personal income grew 0.4% in July, indicating that US economic cooling remains gradual.
RBI's August Bulletin points to domestic macro resilience despite global economic headwinds.
RBI absorbed ₹1.42 lakh crore via VRRR at a 5.24% cutoff rate to maintain overnight liquidity control.

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: Slower US Q2 GDP growth of 1.5% reinforces Fed rate cut expectations and caps US Treasury yield upside
items.what_happened: US real GDP grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in Q2 2026 according to the second estimate, slowing from 2.1% growth in Q1.
items.why_it_matters: Slower US economic expansion cements market expectations for Federal Reserve monetary easing later this year, keeping a lid on US Treasury yields. Softening US yields moderate USD strength and ease capital outflow pressures on emerging markets.
items.action: Revisit US rate cut expectations and portfolio yield duration assumptions ahead of the next FOMC decision.

items.headline: Nvidia's $96bn quarter validates persistent global AI capex momentum, supporting tech valuations
items.what_happened: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $96 billion, exceeding market expectations due to accelerating demand for AI hardware.
items.why_it_matters: Strong enterprise hardware demand demonstrates that the global AI infrastructure investment cycle remains fully intact. Continued mega-cap tech earnings beats provide valuation support for global equity markets.

items.headline: Resilient US consumer income and spending in July signal a gradual rather than abrupt economic cooling
items.what_happened: US personal income grew 0.4% ($115.1 billion) and disposable income increased 0.5% in July, supporting ongoing personal consumption expenditures.
items.why_it_matters: Steady income growth and personal spending show that the US consumer balance sheet remains resilient even as headline GDP growth moderates. This balanced profile reduces immediate US hard-landing risks.

items.headline: BoJ policy address reinforces gradual normalization stance, keeping yen liquidity dynamics in focus
items.what_happened: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Himino delivered a speech in Saitama addressing Japan's economic outlook and monetary policy framework.
items.why_it_matters: The BoJ's ongoing shift away from ultra-accommodative policy remains a key factor for global cross-border capital flows and yen carry trade positioning.

items.headline: Meta's $18bn legal settlement highlights escalating regulatory liability and compliance costs for mega-cap tech
items.what_happened: Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion to settle lawsuits brought by US states claiming its social media platforms caused harm to children.
items.why_it_matters: The massive monetary settlement highlights expanding regulatory and legal liabilities facing major technology platforms, impacting corporate free cash flow and setting a precedent for global platform governance.

items.headline: RBI August Bulletin flags global economic fragility while underscoring domestic growth resilience
items.what_happened: The RBI released its August 2026 Bulletin, featuring its bi-monthly policy statement and the 'State of the Economy' article highlighting fragile global conditions.
items.why_it_matters: The central bank's macroeconomic review stresses that while global tailwinds are constrained by policy uncertainty and slowing trade, Indian domestic activity retains underlying momentum, offering comfort for local debt and credit markets.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: India proposes joint venture pitching initiative with Japan to drive bilateral startup investments
items.what_happened: Union Minister Piyush Goyal proposed an India-Japan startup pitching initiative to connect Indian entrepreneurs with Japanese capital and corporate partners.
items.why_it_matters: Institutionalized cross-border startup channels aim to expand Japanese FDI inflows into domestic technology and manufacturing ventures over the medium term.

items.headline: RBI VRRR auction absorbs ₹1.42 lakh crore at 5.24% cutoff following yesterday's auction announcement
items.what_happened: Following yesterday's auction announcement, the RBI absorbed ₹1.42 lakh crore of banking system liquidity in its 1-day VRRR operation at a 5.24% cutoff rate.
items.why_it_matters: High absorption in the VRRR window shows active liquidity management by the RBI to keep money market rates aligned with policy targets and prevent overnight rates from drifting too low.

items.headline: Skyways Air Services IPO subscribed over 5 times, demonstrating sustained domestic primary market demand
items.what_happened: Skyways Air Services' IPO reached over 5x subscription on day 4, with grey market indicators suggesting a 30% listing premium.
items.why_it_matters: Strong retail and institutional demand for mid-tier equity offerings indicates robust domestic liquidity, supporting overall equity market sentiment.

items.headline: SEBI final order in Varanium Cloud enforces strict accountability for corporate misreporting
items.what_happened: SEBI issued its final order regarding Varanium Cloud Limited following investigations into financial irregularities.
items.why_it_matters: Concluding SEBI enforcement actions reinforce financial reporting standards and regulatory risk premiums for small-cap listed equities.

items.headline: SEBI compliance order against Max Financial Services highlights continued regulatory scrutiny on financial holding structures
items.what_happened: SEBI issued a regulatory order in the matter of Max Financial Services Limited.
items.why_it_matters: Regulatory orders regarding listed financial services entities establish compliance benchmarks and governance standards for corporate group structures.

items.headline: Upcoming ₹34,000 crore GoI bond auction will test primary dealer underwriting demand and sovereign yield levels
items.what_happened: The RBI announced an auction for the re-issue of Government of India securities worth ₹34,000 crore scheduled for Friday, August 28, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: The upcoming debt supply will absorb domestic fixed-income liquidity and provide a fresh price signal for India 10Y G-sec yields.
items.action: Monitor auction cut-off yields on Friday to gauge institutional demand for G-secs.
